turns.assistant_response: Got it—if it says “try again” when you tap, it’s usually a declined card payment or a contactless issue. If you can’t insert, are you able to make another payment attempt at the same terminal?

turns.user_utterance: I stuck it in the chip slot—same “try again” message. No other wording.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—if both tap and chip give only “try again,” it’s most likely a declined card payment. If it still fails, tell me whether this is the first time you’re using the card today and whether you recently changed anything like your passcode/PIN or made a transfer/top up—then I can guide the next step to get it approved.
